scope: Three public practitioner/source profiles verified from their official sites. Public advertisements for private sessions are distinguished from private records, which were not accessed.

sources.title: Who Is Elan?
sources.notes: Presents Elan as an extraterrestrial from Essassani. Says the human channeler uses only his first name. No exact onset date appears. Identity and extraterrestrial origin are source claims.

sources.title: About Elan Interactions
sources.notes: Names the channel Andrew, says initial Bashar transmissions preceded Elan, and describes a free archive. Explicitly requests use of Andrew without a last name. Historical transmission and modern release dates should not be conflated.

sources.title: Odyssey of Ascension: Roxanne Swainhart
sources.notes: Describes Swainhart as a conscious channel associated with Ocyphius and Sylvester, with dialogues since 2013. Claims about transformative effects are promotional self-description, not independently measured outcomes.

sources.title: Master Class & Sessions
sources.notes: States Odyssey of Ascension was created in 2013. Publicly advertises classes and individual one-hour sessions. Read as evidence of an advertised service, not verified client outcomes; no booking or private communication occurred.

sources.title: April Crawford and VERONICA: Welcome
sources.notes: Identifies VERONICA as a nonphysical Causal Plane guide speaking and writing through April Crawford. Publicly advertises one-to-one telephone readings. No founding or first-channeling date was found on this page. Client totals and expertise claims are self-reported.

sources.title: The Inner Whispers Interviews
sources.notes: Official index links recorded Q&A and YouTube interviews. Topics include identity of VERONICA, afterlife, reincarnation, free will and extraterrestrial life. The index documents the published topics, not their factual accuracy.

profiles.name: Elan · Andrew
profiles.origin: Official account presents Essassani as Elan's homeworld.
profiles.dateBasis: Official pages describe older transmissions and later curation, but do not establish an exact first-contact date. Footer copyright is not an onset date.
profiles.summary: Elan Interactions curates transmissions attributed to Elan through a channel named Andrew. Its archive includes initial Bashar material through the same channel and distinguishes the teachings from belief in their extraterrestrial framing.
claims: The official source describes Elan as an extraterrestrial from Essassani.
The archive says Bashar initially worked through Andrew before Elan's sessions.
caveats: Current official attribution requests Andrew only, without a surname; this profile follows that request.
Historical recordings, modern uploads and later publications are different chronological events.
An official archive verifies provenance of the presentation, not an extraterrestrial source.
profiles.services: The retrieved About page emphasizes free recorded material. No current private-session offering was verified.

profiles.name: Roxanne Swainhart · Ocyphius & Sylvester
profiles.origin: The official pages identify the entities but do not establish a specific species or homeworld for this profile.
profiles.dateBasis: Official site states Roxanne created Odyssey of Ascension in 2013 and has facilitated dialogues since 2013.
profiles.summary: Swainhart's Odyssey of Ascension presents conscious channeling, classes and personal guidance associated with Ocyphius, Sylvester and other claimed beings.
claims: The official site describes channeling Ocyphius and Sylvester.
The sessions page says a variety of claimed beings contribute to its themed classes.
caveats: 2013 dates the project's self-reported beginning, not independent verification of any entity.
A species or homeworld was not assigned where the retrieved official pages did not provide one.
Promotional claims of benefits have not been independently established by these sources.
profiles.services: Public site advertises classes and one-hour individual sessions; no private appointment was accessed or booked.

profiles.name: April Crawford · VERONICA
profiles.origin: Official account describes a Causal Plane nonphysical entity and guide rather than an extraterrestrial species.
profiles.dateBasis: The retrieved official biography and media index supply no exact onset year; no date inferred from experience totals or undated publicity.
profiles.summary: Crawford's official site presents full-body open deep-trance channeling of VERONICA, alongside a newsletter, recorded interviews and publicly advertised one-to-one readings.
claims: The official source says VERONICA speaks and writes through Crawford.
The media index presents responses to submitted spiritual questions.
caveats: VERONICA is catalogued as a claimed nonphysical guide, not forced into an ET-species category.
Client counts, professional praise and claimed ability are self-reported promotional statements.
The recorded topics are not proof of afterlife, healing or extraterrestrial claims.
profiles.services: Official site publicly advertises one-to-one telephone readings; no private contacts, client records or sessions were accessed.

events.title: Odyssey of Ascension begins
events.description: Roxanne Swainhart's official sessions page dates creation of Odyssey of Ascension to 2013. This is a practitioner-reported start year.

findings: Elan, Ocyphius/Sylvester and VERONICA broaden the directory while keeping claimed ETs distinct from unspecified entities and nonphysical guides.
Publicly advertised private-session services do not authorize access to private clients, communications or recordings; research here used only public-facing pages.
Elan's official identity policy calls for Andrew without a surname. Peer-discussion names were not repeated in the profile.
No exact start date was manufactured for Elan or VERONICA from copyright notices, upload dates or experience claims.
